The '''lower market districts''' were a group of shopping districts located near the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They contained many shops and stalls, including two [[UGBS/Legends|UGBS]] stalls. The [[Droid Spa/Legends|Coruscant droid spa]] and a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]] were also in located in the lower market districts, and [[Telcom/Legends|Telcom]] was available for use there.

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ordered [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to go to the lower market districts to buy [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruits]] for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aang/Legends|Aang]], as it was his birthday and they needed the fruits for his favorite cake. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] managed to purchase four jogan fruits, though they were swindled out of 32 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] by a [[Khramboan/Legends|Khramboan]] vender, [[Droogan/Legends|Droogan]]. Soon after, they were droidnapped by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and his droid team. Bane wanted to get informations about the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building's]] layout from Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] droids. After the bounty hunter obtained the valuable informations from R2-D2's memory bank, he had the two droids [[Memory wipe/Legends|mind-wiped]], and ordered [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] and [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]] to dump them back on the streets of the lower market districts.<ref name="EP">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>
